'''Ghassan Andoni''' ({{langx|ar|غسان أنضوني}}; born 1956) is a [[Palestinian]] activist.

Born in [[Beit Sahour]] to a [[Palestinian Christian]] family, he is a [[professor]] of [[physics]] at [[Bir Zeit University]] at the [[West Bank]]. He advocates [[nonviolent resistance]] in the [[Israeli–Palestinian conflict|Israeli-Palestinian conflict]].<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Kaufman-Lacusta |first1=Maxine |title=Refusing to Be Enemies: Palestinian and Israeli Nonviolent Resistance to the Israeli Occupation |last2=Franklin |first2=Ursula |author-link2=Ursula Franklin |last3=Ghassan |first3=Andoni |last4=Halper |first4=Jeff |author-link4=Jeff Halper |last5=Kuttab |first5=Jonathan |last6=Starhawk |author-link6=Starhawk |date=2022-07-01 |publisher=Ithaca Press |isbn=9780863725296 |language=English}}</ref>

Andoni is co-founder of the [[International Solidarity Movement]] (ISM), founder of the [[International Middle East Media Centre]] and director of the [[Palestinian Center for Rapprochement between Peoples]] (PCR).<ref>{{Cite web |last=El-Haddad |first=Laila |author-link=Laila el-Haddad |date=2005-07-03 |title=Israeli activist bridges worlds |url=https://palsolidarity.org/2005/07/israeli-activist-bridges-worlds/ |access-date=2024-03-06 |website=The International Solidarity Movement}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=American Friends Service Committee |date=2007-05-10 |title=Profiles of Peace: Faces of Hope campaign |url=https://palsolidarity.org/2007/05/3-ism-cofounders-celebrated/ |access-date=2024-03-06 |website=The International Solidarity Movement}}</ref>

During the [[First Intifada]] Andoni was imprisoned for being involved in Beit Sahour's tax revolt.  In 2006, he was nominated for the [[Nobel Peace Prize]] by the [[American Friends Service Committee]] along with [[Jeff Halper]] of the [[Israeli Committee Against House Demolitions]] (ICAHD).<ref name = "AFSC" />
